title: A clearer path from light to insight
lead: Artifactory explores photonic sensing and the tools used to design it.
description: Two distinct projects connect a measurement ambition with the engineering work behind photonic systems.

sections.title: The company thesis
paragraphs: ArtiSense investigates a compact chemical-sensing concept. AIFIELD develops photonic design and simulation workflows. The connection is useful, but progress in design does not prove a sensing outcome.

sections.title: Where the work stands
paragraphs: The supplied material describes research and design activity, including a glucose chip-design example. Device performance, clinical accuracy and commercial traction are not established by that material.

sections.title: The next conversation
paragraphs: We welcome a company-level investment discussion grounded in the evidence available today and the validation still required.
